say:0:1423345001:0.text: Things in Sal'thorin have been settling down. The priestesses haven't started any trouble. Ravion's probably satisfied with how things are going now.
say:0:1423345001:0.source_cn: 这段时间萨洛克兰的秩序恢复了不少，祭司们也没有异动，沙...

say:1:1423345002:0.text: Why don't we pay him a visit and see how he's doing?
say:1:1423345002:0.source_cn: 不如我们去问问他那边的情况怎么样？

say:2:1423346001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've been meaning to speak with you.
say:2:1423346001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've been meaning to speak with you.
say:2:1423346001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've been meaning to speak with you.

say:3:1423346002:1.text: We received a letter from someone in the Vaduso Mountains requesting to visit Sal'thorin. They said you know each other.
say:3:1423346002:1.source_cn: 有一位来自瓦度索山脉的客人来信称想要访问萨洛克兰，听说...
say:3:1423346002:1.male: We received a letter from someone in the Vaduso Mountains requesting to visit Sal'thorin. They said you know each other.
say:3:1423346002:1.female: We received a letter from someone in the Vaduso Mountains requesting to visit Sal'thorin. They said you know each other.

say:4:1423346003:1.text: I'd like you to give her a tour of Sal'thorin. I assume that won't be a problem?
say:4:1423346003:1.source_cn: 我想请你带她游览萨洛克兰，你应该不会拒绝吧？
say:4:1423346003:1.male: I'd like you to give her a tour of Sal'thorin. I assume that won't be a problem?
say:4:1423346003:1.female: I'd like you to give her a tour of Sal'thorin. I assume that won't be a problem?

say:5:1423346004:1.text: A guest from the Vaduso Mountains? Who could it be? Chippy's curious!
say:5:1423346004:1.source_cn: 来自瓦度索山脉的客人！会是谁呢？满满好期待啊！

say:6:1423346005:1.text: She should be arriving today. We agreed to meet at the royal city's lift.
say:6:1423346005:1.source_cn: 那位客人预计今日就会抵达萨洛克兰，我已与她约定，会在王...

say:7:1423346006:1.text: Alright, let's head to the <style="highlight">Lift Shaft</style> now.
say:7:1423346006:1.source_cn: 我们现在就去<style=highlight>王城升降...

say:0:1423347001:0.source_cn: 那是芙拉贝尔！还有花灵们！

say:3:1423349001:1.text: Florabelle! I can't believe it's really you! What a surprise!
say:3:1423349001:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔！真想不到，远道而来的客人竟然是你！

say:4:1423349002:1.text: It's so good to see you again!
say:4:1423349002:1.source_cn: 能再次见到你真是太高兴了！

say:5:1423349003:1.text: Magister, Chippy, and Hammie! What a joy to reunite with you.
say:5:1423349003:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，满满和漫漫！能再次见到你们，是我的幸运。
say:5:1423349003:1.male: Magister, Chippy, and Hammie! What a joy to reunite with you.
say:5:1423349003:1.female: Magister, Chippy, and Hammie! What a joy to reunite with you.

say:6:1423349004:1.text: But Florabelle, what brings you to Sal'thorin? Weren't you teaching at Jade Lake Academy?
say:6:1423349004:1.source_cn: 可是芙拉贝尔你怎么会来萨洛克兰呢？你不在翡湖学院上课了吗？

say:7:1423349005:1.text: Classes just ended for the semester, so I'm on a short break.
say:7:1423349005:1.source_cn: 最近刚好翡湖学院一学期的课程结束，进入了短暂的假期。

say:8:1423349006:1.text: Eironn wrote to me about everything that's happened here—the past from two thousand years ago, Misarte's curse, the exiled Wilders living underground...
say:8:1423349006:1.source_cn: 埃隆写信告诉了我们萨洛克兰发生的事，两千年前的过去，弥...

say:9:1423349007:1.text: And the wonderful news that the curse has been lifted.
say:9:1423349007:1.source_cn: 还有此处诅咒已经被解除这让人欣慰的消息。

say:10:1423349008:1.text: So I made Sal'thorin our destination for a learning journey with the Bulbsprites.
say:10:1423349008:1.source_cn: 于是，我就把萨洛克兰作为目的地，带着花灵们外出游学啦。

choice_prompt:11:1423349008.text: So I made Sal'thorin our destination for a learning journey with the Bulbsprites.
choice_prompt:11:1423349008.source_cn: 于是，我就把萨洛克兰作为目的地，带着花灵们外出游学啦。

say:12:1423349009:1.text: Exactly. Essail is part of the Wilder line, but their history has been hidden or forgotten for ages.
say:12:1423349009:1.source_cn: 正是如此。艾塞勒是绿裔分支的一部分，但长久以来他们的存...

say:13:1423349010:1.text: As a teacher, I believe it's important to rediscover and pass on their stories.
say:13:1423349010:1.source_cn: 我认为重新了解、教授、传承这些被遗忘的历史，是作为老师...

say:14:1423349011:1.text: Plus, I heard there's a unique underground ecosystem here, and the ruins of the Ironheart Dominion.
say:14:1423349011:1.source_cn: 而且我听说这里还有特殊的地底自然生态和钢心帝国的遗迹。

say:15:1423349012:1.text: Where else can you find so much to learn and experience in one place, right?
say:15:1423349012:1.source_cn: 一处地点同时汇集了如此丰富的知识与体验……不会有比这里...

say:17:1423349014:1.text: Florabelle, if you'd like a tour, we'd be happy to be your guides!
say:17:1423349014:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔，如果你想参观萨洛克兰的话，我们可以做你的向导哦！

say:18:1423349015:1.text: Magister knows the area well and has met lots of Essail too!
say:18:1423349015:1.source_cn: 主人已经对这里很熟悉了，还认识很多艾塞勒呢！
say:18:1423349015:1.male: Magister knows the area well and has met lots of Essail too!
say:18:1423349015:1.female: Magister knows the area well and has met lots of Essail too!

say:19:1423349016:1.text: In that case, Magister, do you know anyone here with deep knowledge of Sal'thorin's history, customs, and traditions? I'd love to ask them a few questions.
say:19:1423349016:1.source_cn: 既然如此，梅林大人是否认识对萨洛克兰的历史、习俗、礼仪...
say:19:1423349016:1.male: In that case, Magister, do you know anyone here with deep knowledge of Sal'thorin's history, customs, and traditions? I'd love to ask them a few questions.
say:19:1423349016:1.female: In that case, Magister, do you know anyone here with deep knowledge of Sal'thorin's history, customs, and traditions? I'd love to ask them a few questions.

say:20:1423349017:1.text: History, customs, traditions... Hmm, it has to be someone who's really well-read...
say:20:1423349017:1.source_cn: 历史、习俗、礼仪……应该是对书本上的知识十分了解的人吧……

choice_prompt:21:1423349017.text: History, customs, traditions... Hmm, it has to be someone who's really well-read...
choice_prompt:21:1423349017.source_cn: 历史、习俗、礼仪……应该是对书本上的知识十分了解的人吧……

say:22:1423349018:1.text: Right! She used to be a priestess. She should know all about that stuff!
say:22:1423349018:1.source_cn: 对呀！欧罗娜之前当过祭司，应该会对这些知识有所了解！

say:23:1423349019:1.text: Let's head to the Lunaris Altar and see if she's around.
say:23:1423349019:1.source_cn: 我们去银月祭庭附近找找她？

say:24:1423349020:1.text: Thank you all. I can't wait to meet this Orlana you speak so highly of.
say:24:1423349020:1.source_cn: 感谢你们，我迫不及待要与你们口中的欧罗娜见面了。

choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 把萨洛克兰作为目的地？

say:1:1423350001:1.text: Ah, Magister! Fancy meeting you again. I just sorted through some books I don't need anymore and thought I'd bring them to the kids in the district.
say:1:1423350001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，又见面了！我最近收拾了一些家里闲置的书籍，刚...
say:1:1423350001:1.male: Ah, Magister! Fancy meeting you again. I just sorted through some books I don't need anymore and thought I'd bring them to the kids in the district.
say:1:1423350001:1.female: Ah, Magister! Fancy meeting you again. I just sorted through some books I don't need anymore and thought I'd bring them to the kids in the district.

say:3:1423350002:1.text: And who's this? I don't think we've met.
say:3:1423350002:1.source_cn: 哎，这位没见过的小姐是你们的朋友？

say:5:1423350003:1.text: This is Florabelle, from the Vaduso Mountains. She's a teacher, and these are her students, the Bulbsprites, from Jade Lake Academy.
say:5:1423350003:1.source_cn: 这位是来自瓦度索山脉的芙拉贝尔，她是一名老师哦！这几位...

say:6:1423350004:1.text: She's here with her students on a learning journey through Sal'thorin. Kind of like a study trip—learning through exploration!
say:6:1423350004:1.source_cn: 她是带学生们来萨洛克兰游学的，你理解为边游览边学习一些...

say:7:1423350005:1.text: Florabelle, this is Orlana, the one we told you about.
say:7:1423350005:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔，这位就是我们跟你提过的欧罗娜啦。

say:8:1423350006:1.text: Florabelle's hoping to ask a few questions about Sal'thorin's history, traditions, and customs. Naturally, we thought of you!
say:8:1423350006:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔想向熟悉萨洛克兰历史、习俗、礼仪这类知识的艾塞...

say:10:1423350007:1.text: You brought students all this way just to study? That's amazing!
say:10:1423350007:1.source_cn: 从这么远的地方带学生来萨洛克兰游学……好厉害！

say:11:1423350008:1.text: Miss Florabelle wants to ask me questions? I... I'm not sure I know enough to be much help.
say:11:1423350008:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔小姐想向我请教吗……可是我学识粗浅，不知道能不...

say:12:1423350009:1.text: I overheard you say you were bringing those books to the kids in the district. Are you a teacher too?
say:12:1423350009:1.source_cn: 我刚刚听到欧罗娜你说要把书带给平民区的孩子们，你也是一...

say:13:1423350010:1.text: Nah... I wouldn't go that far. I used to be a priestess, that's all...
say:13:1423350010:1.source_cn: 不是啦……才我没有那么厉害呢。我之前是一名祭司……

say:14:1423350011:1.text: You said you were going to the commoners' district to bring books to the kids. Mind if we come with you? That way we can ask questions if something catches our interest.
say:14:1423350011:1.source_cn: 你说想去平民区给孩子们送书，我们可以与你同行吗？这样如...

say:15:1423350012:1.text: Of course! Come along. It's this way.
say:15:1423350012:1.source_cn: 当然可以！我们从这边走吧。

say:17:1423350013:1.text: You really know your way around now, Orlana.
say:17:1423350013:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜已经越来越轻车熟路啦。

say:0:1423351001:0.text: Hey, it's the nice lady from before!

say:1:1423352001:1.text: Jamie, Ms. Helina! How have you been?
say:1:1423352001:1.source_cn: 詹米，胡丽诺女士，你们最近过得怎么样呀？

say:2:1423352002:1.text: Jamie's been talking about you ever since you left. Go ahead, Jamie, say something to Miss Orlana.
say:2:1423352002:1.source_cn: 自从你上次离开后，詹米一直念叨着你呢。詹米，跟欧罗娜小...

say:3:1423352003:1.text: ... Miss Orlana.., I'm really happy to see you again. No one's ever given me a gift before...
say:3:1423352003:1.source_cn: ……大姐姐，能再见到你……我好高兴！有人送我礼物，还是...

say:4:1423352004:1.text: I'm glad you liked it. Last time I only brought one book. This time, I brought a bunch. You can read them with your friends.
say:4:1423352004:1.source_cn: 你喜欢就好！上次我只带了一本书，这次我给你带了好多书呢...

say:7:1423352006:1.text: Oh! These are Miss Florabelle and her students. They're here to learn about Sal'thorin.
say:7:1423352006:1.source_cn: 对了！这是芙拉贝尔老师和她的学生，她们想了解和萨洛克兰...

say:9:1423352007:1.text: Hi, Jamie! I'm one of the Bulbsprites from the Vaduso Mountains!
say:9:1423352007:1.source_cn: 詹米你好！我是来自瓦度索山脉的花灵！

choice_prompt:10:1423352007.text: Hi, Jamie! I'm one of the Bulbsprites from the Vaduso Mountains!
choice_prompt:10:1423352007.source_cn: 詹米你好！我是来自瓦度索山脉的花灵！

say:12:1423352009:1.text: You've lived here your whole life, right Jamie? You probably know this area better than anyone.
say:12:1423352009:1.source_cn: 詹米，你一直生活在这里，对这里的自然环境应该很熟悉吧？

say:13:1423352010:1.text: Would you like to be our guide and show us around?
say:13:1423352010:1.source_cn: 你愿意做我们的向导，带我们了解这里吗？

say:15:1423352011:1.text: They're with Miss Orlana, so go ahead if you want to.
say:15:1423352011:1.source_cn: 既然是跟欧罗娜小姐一起，你想去就去吧。

say:18:1423352013:1.text: Hehe, our little group just keeps growing.
say:18:1423352013:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，我们的队伍越来越壮大啦！

choice:10:0:1.text: It's okay, Jamie. Don't be nervous.
choice:10:0:1.male: It's okay, Jamie. Don't be nervous.
choice:10:0:1.female: It's okay, Jamie. Don't be nervous.

say:0:1423353001:0.text: So this is where the Essail live?
say:0:1423353001:0.source_cn: 这里就是艾塞勒生活的区域吗？

say:1:1423353002:0.text: After Queen Seralyth founded Sal'thorin, she divided the city into noble and commoner areas. This is where most of the commoners settled.
say:1:1423353002:0.source_cn: 奈萨雷斯……也就是前女王建立萨洛克兰后，曾经作出了贵族...

say:0:1423354001:0.text: Hey, there's a path down this way!

say:1:1423354002:0.text: Don't worry, the vines are strong. You won't fall!
say:1:1423354002:0.source_cn: 放心，这些藤蔓很结实！不会把人摔下去的！

say:1:1423355001:1.text: That's one huge statue... there's something unusual about it.
say:1:1423355001:1.source_cn: 这座巨大的雕像……有些特别。

say:2:1423355002:1.text: That's one of the old statues of Helthor, the God of Mining and Metallurgy. The dwarves used to worship him.
say:2:1423355002:1.source_cn: 这里是采矿与冶金之神赫托的雕像遗迹之一，赫托是矮人所信...

say:3:1423355003:1.text: According to the records, Seralyth built the Essail royal city on the ruins of the Ironheart Dominion.
say:3:1423355003:1.source_cn: 典籍上记载着，奈萨雷斯正是在钢心帝国的旧址上建立了艾塞...

say:4:1423355004:1.text: That's why Sal'thorin still has so many ruins from the kingdom—statues, arches, old water systems... I've got that right, haven't I?
say:4:1423355004:1.source_cn: 因此，在如今的萨洛克兰留存着很多钢心帝国的遗迹，不仅有...

choice_prompt:5:1423355004.text: That's why Sal'thorin still has so many ruins from the kingdom—statues, arches, old water systems... I've got that right, haven't I?
choice_prompt:5:1423355004.source_cn: 因此，在如今的萨洛克兰留存着很多钢心帝国的遗迹，不仅有雕像，还有建筑拱梁，水利设施的遗迹等……我说的应该对吧……

say:6:1423355005:1.text: You really know your stuff, Orlana.

say:7:1423355006:1.text: Alright, kids, can anyone tell me who that big man with the beard and hammer is?
say:7:1423355006:1.source_cn: 孩子们，可以告诉老师这位有着大胡子、手里拿着巨锤的老爷...

say:9:1423355007:4.text: I know! He's the mining god!

say:11:1423355009:1.text: I think she said he works with metal too!
say:11:1423355009:1.source_cn: 我记得那位姐姐说过，他也会冶炼金属！

say:13:1423355010:3.text: Put your answers together, and you've nailed it.
say:13:1423355010:3.source_cn: 把大家的回答组织在一起，就是正确的答案啦。

say:14:1423355011:1.source_cn: 哇，芙拉贝尔开始现场教学了……

say:0:1423356001:0.text: This camp is where people stay when they're out hunting or fishing.
say:0:1423356001:0.source_cn: 这里的营地是大人们打猎或捕鱼的时候住的地方。

say:1:1423356002:0.text: It's too dangerous to sleep out in the open. You could get attacked by wild beasts like capshrooms!
say:1:1423356002:0.source_cn: 不可以直接住在野外……否则会被幻灵孢菇之类的野兽袭击…...

say:2:1423357002:1.text: They're part of an old water system from the Ironheart Dominion.
say:2:1423357002:1.source_cn: 这些就是钢心帝国水利设施的遗迹。

say:3:1423357003:1.text: Sal'thorin has lots of underground rivers and uneven terrain. Perfect for building things like this to power machines.
say:3:1423357003:1.source_cn: 萨洛克兰的地下暗河水系丰富，落差又较多，很适合修建这样...

say:4:1423357004:1.text: In the early days of Sal'thorin, one of the sages suggested restoring the system, but Seralyth said there weren't enough people to do the work and shot down the idea...
say:4:1423357004:1.source_cn: 萨洛克兰建国初期曾经有贤者提议能否重新利用这些水利设施...

say:7:1423357006:1.text: The dwarves built these huge gears on a waterfall! They're incredible!
say:7:1423357006:1.source_cn: 矮人们真了不起，能在瀑布上修建这么大的齿轮！

say:8:1423357007:1.text: And they've survived thousands of years of rushing water. Do keep that in mind!
say:8:1423357007:1.source_cn: 这些是历经数千年的流水冲刷依然能保留下来的遗迹，要好好...

say:1:1423358001:1.text: That bridge we crossed... Was it really made of mushrooms?
say:1:1423358001:1.source_cn: 我们刚刚走过的桥，是巨大的蕈类搭建而成的吗……？

say:3:1423358002:1.text: That's the Mushroom Bridge... But trust me, those giant mushrooms taste terrible!
say:3:1423358002:1.source_cn: 那是大蘑菇桥……这种大蘑菇不好吃！

say:4:1423358003:1.text: Haha, Jamie's really looking the part of a tour guide!
say:4:1423358003:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，詹米的讲解也越来越有模有样了呢。

say:5:1423358004:1.text: The plants here are so different from the ones in the Vaduso Mountains. Can you tell me more about them?
say:5:1423358004:1.source_cn: 这里的植被和瓦度索山脉有很大不同，我想多了解一些，你们...

say:7:1423358005:1.text: Sure! That one with the white stem and purple cap is a fuzzy mushroom. They're everywhere around here and we eat them a lot.
say:7:1423358005:1.source_cn: 当然没问题！这种白杆紫色伞盖的菌菇名叫茸茸伞菇，在萨洛...

say:8:1423358006:1.text: And this flower, with purple petals and a yellow center...
say:8:1423358006:1.source_cn: 这种紫色花瓣黄色花蕊的花……

say:9:1423358007:1.text: That's called an etching iris! My mom says it's poisonous, except for the roots. The roots are spicy!
say:9:1423358007:1.source_cn: 这是蚀芯花！妈妈告诉我它全身上下只有根茎没毒，吃起来辣辣的！

say:11:1423358009:1.text: Want to learn more, kids? Go ahead and get a closer look!
say:11:1423358009:1.source_cn: 孩子们，想要更了解它们吗？去近距离观察一下它们吧！

say:17:1423358013:1.text: Miss Florabelle, you're incredible. You really know how to get the kids interested. They're having so much fun learning...
say:17:1423358013:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔老师，你真的很厉害。你的教学不仅牢牢吸引了她们...

say:18:1423358014:1.text: How did you become such a great teacher?
say:18:1423358014:1.source_cn: 你是怎样成为一名好老师的呢？

say:19:1423358015:1.text: That's such a kind thing to say. Thank you.
say:19:1423358015:1.source_cn: 这样的称赞……我受宠若惊。

say:20:1423358016:1.text: I've spent a lot of time thinking about how to make learning enjoyable—something they'll want to keep doing.
say:20:1423358016:1.source_cn: 不过我确实经常思考，怎样的教学会让她们感受到学习的乐趣...

say:21:1423358017:1.text: That's why I use lots of games in class.
say:21:1423358017:1.source_cn: 为此，我还设计了不少小游戏呢。

say:22:1423358018:1.text: Games? Can you show me one?

say:23:1423358019:1.text: Let's use the fuzzy mushroom and etching iris as examples. I'll show you using the picture card matching game we often play.
say:23:1423358019:1.source_cn: 就以茸茸伞菇和蚀芯花作为教学目标，以我常用的卡片识图游...

say:24:1423358020:1.text: I draw cards with pictures of the plants. The students match them to the names. It helps them remember...
say:24:1423358020:1.source_cn: 我会绘制很多带有茸茸伞菇与蚀芯花图案的卡片，让学生识别...

narration:25:1423358021:1.text: Florabelle takes out her tools and quickly sketches the cards—some with the fuzzy mushroom, some with the etching iris.

say:26:1423358022:1.text: It's easy to learn. Want to try it, Orlana? And you too, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:26:1423358022:1.source_cn: 只要玩过一遍就会知道规则，欧罗娜要来试一试吗？<sty...
say:26:1423358022:1.male: It's easy to learn. Want to try it, Orlana? And you too, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:26:1423358022:1.female: It's easy to learn. Want to try it, Orlana? And you too, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:1:1423359001:1.text: All that just to teach a single topic...
say:1:1423359001:1.source_cn: 仅仅是为了教学一个知识点，都设计得如此用心……

say:2:1423359002:1.text: No wonder the kids love learning from you, Florabelle.
say:2:1423359002:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔，我大概知道你为什么会受孩子们欢迎了。

say:3:1423359003:1.text: It's true that constant learning and improving your teaching skills matters, but that's not what makes the biggest difference.
say:3:1423359003:1.source_cn: 其实，持续不断的学习和磨炼教学技巧固然重要，但都不是决...

say:4:1423359004:1.text: The most important thing is caring. Really caring about the kids, seeing the world through their eyes, and becoming someone they trust...
say:4:1423359004:1.source_cn: 最重要的是要发自内心地去关爱孩子，理解孩子，直至走进孩...

say:5:1423359005:1.text: Orlana, I think you know how to do that too.
say:5:1423359005:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜，我觉得你也有这样的一颗心呢。

choice_prompt:6:1423359005.text: Orlana, I think you know how to do that too.
choice_prompt:6:1423359005.source_cn: 欧罗娜，我觉得你也有这样的一颗心呢。

say:9:1423359007:1.text: Miss Florabelle, we finished observing the plants! I counted five stamens on the etching iris!
say:9:1423359007:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔老师，我们观察完啦，我发现蚀芯花有五根花蕊。

say:10:1423359008:1.text: And I saw rings on the fuzzy mushroom's cap, like little ripples!
say:10:1423359008:1.source_cn: 我发现茸茸伞菇的伞面上有一圈一圈的花纹！

say:11:1423359009:1.text: You both made great discoveries! We've already learned so much today. Are you getting a little tired?
say:11:1423359009:1.source_cn: 你们的发现都很棒！今天我们已经学习了很多知识，你们是不...

say:14:1423359011:1.text: Jamie's walked with us this whole time. We should bring him home before his mom starts to worry.
say:14:1423359011:1.source_cn: 詹米也跟我们走了很久，该回家啦，我们把他送回家吧？否则...

say:0:1423360001:0.text: It's been such a rewarding day... Let's head back to Jamie's place first.
say:0:1423360001:0.source_cn: 很有收获的一天呢……我们先回詹米家吧。

say:1:1423361001:1.text: Not at all, Ms. Helina. And we brought him back safe and sound.
say:1:1423361001:1.source_cn: 胡丽诺女士，我们把詹米带回来啦。

say:2:1423361002:1.text: He was great! He even told us all kinds of things about the commoners' district.
say:2:1423361002:1.source_cn: 詹米今天表现很棒呢，给我们讲了很多关于平民区的事。

say:3:1423361003:1.text: Kids, what do we say to Jamie, Orlana, and <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:3:1423361003:1.source_cn: 孩子们，向詹米、欧罗娜、还有<style=stress...
say:3:1423361003:1.male: Kids, what do we say to Jamie, Orlana, and <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:3:1423361003:1.female: Kids, what do we say to Jamie, Orlana, and <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:9:1423361007:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm planning to take the kids back to the royal city to rest for a bit. Once they're settled, I'll plan our next stop...
say:9:1423361007:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm planning to take the kids back to the royal city to rest for a bit. Once they're settled, I'll plan our next stop...
say:9:1423361007:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm planning to take the kids back to the royal city to rest for a bit. Once they're settled, I'll plan our next stop...

say:11:1423361008:1.text: So this is goodbye for now?

say:12:1423361009:1.text: It's hard to part, but I know we'll see each other again!
say:12:1423361009:1.source_cn: 虽然不舍，但我相信我们会再见的！

say:15:1423361011:1.text: Goodbye, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Chippy, Hammie—and Orlana. Believe in yourself!
say:15:1423361011:1.male: Goodbye, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Chippy, Hammie—and Orlana. Believe in yourself!
say:15:1423361011:1.female: Goodbye, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Chippy, Hammie—and Orlana. Believe in yourself!

narration:17:1423361012:1.text: After saying goodbye, Florabelle and her Bulbsprites leave...

say:19:1423361013:1.text: The lady and her students left... Orlana, are you leaving too?
say:19:1423361013:1.source_cn: 那位大姐姐和她的学生走了……欧罗娜姐姐，你也要走吗？

say:20:1423361014:1.text: I... I really envy those students. They're lucky to have such a wonderful teacher...
say:20:1423361014:1.source_cn: ……其实、其实我很羡慕那几个花灵，她们有那位大姐姐当老师……

say:21:1423361015:1.text: Orlana, I love the book you gave me, but... I can't read. I only look at the pictures and try to guess what they mean...
say:21:1423361015:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜姐姐，你送给我的书我很喜欢，但是……我不认识字，...

say:22:1423361016:1.text: Do you think... maybe you could be our teacher? Not just for me, but for my friends too. If someone could teach us...
say:22:1423361016:1.source_cn: 你不可以当我的老师吗？还有我的朋友们，如果有老师愿意教...

say:23:1423361017:1.source_cn: 詹米，其实……我愿意！我愿意当你们的老师……

choice_prompt:24:1423361017.source_cn: 詹米，其实……我愿意！我愿意当你们的老师……

say:25:1423361018:1.text: Thank you, Magister. Thank you, Chippy and Hammie. Because of you guys, I've finally figured out what I want to do.
say:25:1423361018:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，满满，漫漫，谢谢你们这段时间陪我，让我找到了...
say:25:1423361018:1.male: Thank you, Magister. Thank you, Chippy and Hammie. Because of you guys, I've finally figured out what I want to do.
say:25:1423361018:1.female: Thank you, Magister. Thank you, Chippy and Hammie. Because of you guys, I've finally figured out what I want to do.

say:26:1423361019:1.text: These kids here need me. And I think I need them too.
say:26:1423361019:1.source_cn: 这里的孩子需要我留在这里，我觉得，我也需要他们。

say:27:1423361020:1.text: I still have so much to learn about being a teacher. But I'm ready to try. I believe the kids will show me, little by little, what they really need...
say:27:1423361020:1.source_cn: 虽然对于如何做一个老师我还有很多事情不了解，但我愿意踏...

say:28:1423361021:1.text: More than anything, I want to be someone who helps them feel seen—someone who gives them the courage to take that first step toward building a life of their own...
say:28:1423361021:1.source_cn: 我一定会做一个好老师，让这些孩子们感觉到，有人愿意帮助...

say:29:1423361022:1.text: You're really going to be my teacher? This is the best! I'm telling everyone right now!
say:29:1423361022:1.source_cn: 耶！欧罗娜要当我的老师了！我要去告诉朋友们！

say:30:1423361023:1.text: Jamie, hold on! ...Oh, forget it. I'll come with you!
say:30:1423361023:1.source_cn: 詹米，等等……算了，我跟你一起去找他们吧！

choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 欧罗娜变得自信起来了

say:0:1423362001:0.text: So Orlana's finally found her calling. That feels like a good way for this story to end.
say:0:1423362001:0.source_cn: 欧罗娜终于找到了想做的事……总归是个好结局呢。

say:1:1423362002:0.text: I wonder what Ravion will think when he hears this. Let's go find him!
say:1:1423362002:0.source_cn: 不知道沙利叶听到这件事会有什么想法，我们去找他吧！

say:2:1423363001:1.text: A priestess choosing to teach the children of the commoners... It's such a simple thing, but there's something moving about it...
say:2:1423363001:1.source_cn: 一名祭司选择成为平民区孩子们的老师……这个故事虽然日常...

say:3:1423363002:1.text: And the best part? It's all real.

say:4:1423363003:1.text: What you've just told me—it's shown a side of Sal'thorin I hadn't seen before. Behind all the talk of progress and reform, people are still struggling...
say:4:1423363003:1.source_cn: 你们告诉我的事，让我看到了萨洛克兰隐藏在繁荣向上的革新...

say:5:1423363004:1.text: A young priestess, lost and confused. Families with no schools. Children with no one to guide them...
say:5:1423363004:1.source_cn: 陷入迷茫的年轻祭司，缺乏学校与教师的普通民众，还有那些...

say:6:1423363005:1.text: It was my oversight not to see it. I'll do better.
say:6:1423363005:1.source_cn: 没有关注到这些，是我的失职，我会加以反省的。

say:7:1423363006:1.text: Orlana, was it? I'll seek her out myself. She deserves to be thanked.
say:7:1423363006:1.source_cn: 那位祭司……她是叫欧罗娜吧？我会亲自找到她，向她表达我...

say:8:1423363007:1.text: And I give you my word, those children won't be left behind. They will have a good future here.
say:8:1423363007:1.source_cn: 我向你们承诺，那些孩子不会重复祖辈的命运，他们会有一个...
